with_lifestyle returns loc unchanged if id not in LIFESTYLE_SCORES; all 7 known locality ids are covered so list endpoint always attaches lifestyle. If a new locality is added without a LIFESTYLE_SCORES entry, list-level assertion would fail. Consider a default score or explicit null.
